- Renamed the skill to "linked-list-practice-helper-2" and updated references accordingly.
- Updated agent and reference files to reflect the new skill name.

Initial release of the "assist-feat-add-frequently-asked-linked-list" skill.

- Provides structured assistance for adding frequently asked Linked List problems from major MNCs (Amazon, Google, Microsoft).
- Supports requests related to practical workflows, artifacts, checklists, analysis, and implementation for this feature.
- Includes a step-by-step workflow to restate requirements, generate outputs, and validate results.
- Activated by relevant keywords and example trigger sentences to guide users.
